drhp.business: Om Power Transmission is a power transmission infrastructure EPC company with 14+ years of experience, executing high-voltage and extra-high-voltage transmission lines (11 kV to 400 kV), substations (up to 220 kV) and underground cabling on a turnkey basis, plus long-term O&M services. Clients are primarily state utilities/PSUs (e.g., GETCO) and private renewable/industrial developers.

drhp.expansion: Historically concentrated in Gujarat, the Company has recently expanded operations to Rajasthan, Punjab and the union territory of Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu, having secured EPC awards in these geographies. It plans capital expenditure on machinery and equipment funded partly from the fresh issue.

sk.overview: The power transmission infrastructure EPC segment covers turnkey execution of high-voltage/extra-high-voltage transmission lines, substations and underground cabling that carry bulk power from generation sources to load centres. Per the issuer-commissioned Dun & Bradstreet Report, transmission lines minimise long-distance energy losses, provide grid stability by interconnecting regions, and are critical for integrating geographically isolated renewable (solar/wind) generation into the main grid. Growth is underpinned by India's infrastructure and renewable-energy build-out.
